strings.settings.a11yHint: Reduced motion, captions, larger HUD text, shape status cues, and reel timing meter. Timing Sights / Master Reel upgrades still widen the sim window.

strings.settings.dailyRemindersHint: Local evening reminder when unclaimed daily goals remain. Opt-in; no remote push.
strings.settings.hapticsHint: Short vibration on catch and sale.
strings.settings.languageHint: UI, listing, and content-pack display names follow this language.
strings.settings.muteHint: Master silence for music beds and stingers. Haptics stay independent.
strings.settings.qualityHint: Targets ~30 FPS on mid-tier Android. Soft-downgrades if frames stay over budget.
strings.settings.reducedMotionHint: Snaps the camera follow and skips flying transfer VFX.
strings.settings.shapeCuesHint: Adds ▶ ■ ◆ glyphs beside station and reel status so colour is not the only signal.
strings.settings.tapToMoveHint: Tap the harbor to walk there. Stick and keys still work.
strings.settings.telemetryHint: Privacy-safe counters (fish.telemetry.v2) and content balance knobs. Copied as JSON.
strings.settings.themeHint: HUD chrome follows system, or stays light/dark.
strings.settings.timingMeterHint: Shows Good / Perfect bands while casting. Buy Timing Sights or Master Reel to widen the window.
strings.settings.title: Settings
